excerpts.label: Early window
excerpts.quote: I reciprocate your kind prayers for the protection and blessing of the common Father and Creator of man, and tender you for yourselves and your religious association, assurances of my high respect and esteem.

excerpts.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Response to Danbury Baptist Association, 1802

excerpts.label: Recent window
excerpts.quote: In America, we celebrate faith, we cherish religion, we lift our voices in prayer, and we raise our sights to the Glory of God.

excerpts.cite: Donald Trump, State of the Union Address, 2020

fine_topics.name: Providence, Faith & American Ideals
fine_topics.definition: Invocations of Almighty God and Providence, calls for prayer and thanksgiving, and appeals to patriotism, civic ideals, and the shared moral character of the nation.

fine_topics.name: Commemoration, Eulogy & National Mourning
fine_topics.definition: Ceremonial tributes to founders and heroes, eulogies for departed statesmen, anniversary commemorations, and consoling the nation in mourning.

fine_topics.name: Polygamy in the Territories
fine_topics.definition: Legislation aimed at suppressing polygamy and bigamy in Utah and other Territories through marriage records, witness rules, and voting and office restrictions.
